item.title: Nolan Wells update: Friend blames mother for fueling backlash and threats after death
item.summary: Jax Pitalo has accused Christine Wonsley of helping fuel the online backlash against him and two other friends after Nolan Wells’ death. Pitalo and Warren Hudson said the friends have faced threats and harassment after their identities became public. They deny involvement in Wells’ death and say they are considering legal action over false claims made about them.
